lessons.title: Git Fundamentals
lessons.theory: Git quản lý version control. commit lưu snapshot. branch tạo nhánh phát triển song song. merge hợp nhất branches.
lessons.code:
# Init & Config
git init
git config --global user.name "DevMaster"
git config --global user.email "dev@master.com"

# Basic workflow
git add .                    # Stage all changes
git commit -m "feat: add login page"
git status                   # Check status
git log --oneline -5         # View history

# Branching
git branch feature/auth      # Create branch
git checkout feature/auth    # Switch branch
# Or: git checkout -b feature/auth (create + switch)

git add .
git commit -m "feat: add JWT auth"

git checkout main
git merge feature/auth       # Merge to main
git branch -d feature/auth   # Delete merged branch

# Remote
git remote add origin https://github.com/user/repo.git
git push -u origin main
git pull origin main
keyPoints: git add → git commit → git push workflow
Branching: tạo branch cho mỗi feature, merge khi xong
Commit messages: type(scope): description (conventional)
lessons.exercise: Tạo repo, commit 3 lần, tạo branch, merge, push lên GitHub.

lessons.title: Docker Basics
lessons.theory: Docker đóng gói app + dependencies vào container. Dockerfile định nghĩa cách build image. Containers chạy isolated, consistent mọi nơi.
lessons.code:
# Dockerfile
FROM node:20-alpine

WORKDIR /app

# Copy deps first (caching)
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production

# Copy source
COPY . .

EXPOSE 3000

CMD ["node", "server.js"]

# .dockerignore
# node_modules
# .git
# .env

# Build & Run
# docker build -t myapp .
# docker run -d -p 3000:3000 --name myapp myapp

# Useful commands
# docker ps              # running containers
# docker logs myapp      # view logs
# docker exec -it myapp sh  # shell into container
# docker stop myapp      # stop
# docker rm myapp        # remove
keyPoints: FROM base image, WORKDIR set directory, COPY transfer files
Layer caching: COPY package.json trước, npm install, sau COPY source
docker build -t name . tạo image, docker run chạy container

lessons.title: Git Branching Strategies
lessons.theory: Git Flow: main, develop, feature/*, release/*, hotfix/*. GitHub Flow: main + feature branches + PR. Rebase vs Merge. Conventional commits.
lessons.code:
# GitHub Flow (simple, recommended)
git checkout -b feature/user-auth

# Work...
git add .
git commit -m "feat(auth): add JWT login endpoint"
git commit -m "test(auth): add login unit tests"
git commit -m "docs(auth): update API documentation"

# Push and create PR
git push -u origin feature/user-auth
# Create Pull Request on GitHub

# Rebase before merge (clean history)
git checkout feature/user-auth
git rebase main
# Resolve conflicts if any
git push --force-with-lease

# After PR approved & merged
git checkout main
git pull origin main
git branch -d feature/user-auth

# Interactive rebase (clean up commits)
git rebase -i HEAD~3
# pick, squash, reword, drop

# Stash (save work temporarily)
git stash
git checkout other-branch
# do stuff...
git checkout feature-branch
git stash pop
keyPoints: GitHub Flow: main → feature branch → PR → merge → delete
Conventional commits: feat:, fix:, docs:, test:, chore:
Rebase cho clean history, merge cho team collaboration
lessons.exercise: Practice Git Flow: tạo feature, hotfix, release branches.

lessons.title: Docker Compose & Multi-container
lessons.theory: Docker Compose orchestrate nhiều containers cùng lúc. Một file docker-compose.yml định nghĩa tất cả services, networks, volumes.
lessons.code:
# docker-compose.yml
version: "3.8"

services:
  app:
    build: .
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - DATABASE_URL=postgres://user:pass@db:5432/myapp
      - REDIS_URL=redis://cache:6379
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      cache:
        condition: service_started
    volumes:
      - ./src:/app/src  # dev: hot reload

  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: user
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: pass
      POSTGRES_DB: myapp
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U user"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  cache:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"

volumes:
  postgres_data:

# Commands:
# docker compose up -d      # start all
# docker compose logs -f    # follow logs
# docker compose down -v    # stop & remove volumes
keyPoints: services: định nghĩa mỗi container (app, db, cache)
depends_on + healthcheck đảm bảo startup order
volumes: persist data khi container restart
lessons.exercise: Compose full-stack app: Node.js + PostgreSQL + Redis.

lessons.title: Merge Conflicts & Recovery
lessons.theory: Conflicts xảy ra khi 2 branches sửa cùng file. Resolve bằng cách chọn code đúng. git reflog recovery tool. git bisect tìm commit gây bug.
lessons.code:
# When conflict occurs:
git merge feature/auth
# CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in src/app.js

# The file will contain:
<<<<<<< HEAD
  const port = 3000;
=======
  const port = process.env.PORT || 8080;
>>>>>>> feature/auth

# Fix: choose correct code, remove markers
  const port = process.env.PORT || 3000;

git add src/app.js
git commit -m "fix: resolve merge conflict in app.js"

# Recovery tools
git reflog              # view ALL history (even deleted)
git reset --hard HEAD~1 # undo last commit (DANGEROUS)
git revert HEAD         # create new commit that undoes

# Find bug-introducing commit
git bisect start
git bisect bad          # current commit has bug
git bisect good v1.0    # this version was fine
# Git will checkout middle commits
# Test each: git bisect good/bad
# Eventually finds the exact commit!
git bisect reset
keyPoints: <<<< HEAD / ==== / >>>> branch markers cho conflict
git reflog: recovery cho mọi thao tác đã mất
git bisect: binary search tìm commit gây bug
lessons.exercise: Tạo conflict cố tình giữa 2 branches và resolve chúng.

lessons.title: CI/CD Pipelines
lessons.theory: CI (Continuous Integration): auto-test mỗi push. CD (Continuous Deployment): auto-deploy khi tests pass. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins.
lessons.code:
# .github/workflows/deploy.yml
name: CI/CD Pipeline
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: 20 }
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm test -- --coverage

  build:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build Docker Image
        run: docker build -t myapp:${{ github.sha }} .
      - name: Push to Registry
        run: |
          docker tag myapp:${{ github.sha }} registry.example.com/myapp:latest
          docker push registry.example.com/myapp:latest

  deploy:
    needs: build
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Deploy
        run: |
          ssh deploy@server "docker pull registry.example.com/myapp:latest && docker compose up -d"
keyPoints: CI: test → lint → build on every push/PR
CD: auto-deploy to production after tests pass
needs: job1 cho dependency order giữa jobs
lessons.exercise: Setup GitHub Actions CI/CD cho project: test → build → deploy.

lessons.title: Docker Production Patterns
lessons.theory: Multi-stage builds giảm image size. Health checks. Security: non-root user, minimal base image. Docker layer optimization. Environment variables.
lessons.code:
# Multi-stage build
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

# Production image (smaller)
FROM node:20-alpine AS production
WORKDIR /app

# Security: non-root user
RUN addgroup -g 1001 appgroup && \
    adduser -u 1001 -G appgroup -s /bin/sh -D appuser

COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=builder /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=builder /app/package.json ./

# Health check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --retries=3 \
  CMD wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1

USER appuser
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]
keyPoints: Multi-stage: builder stage compiles, production stage chỉ chứa output
Non-root USER cho security (không chạy container as root)
HEALTHCHECK cho container orchestration biết service healthy
lessons.exercise: Optimize Docker image từ 1GB xuống <200MB dùng multi-stage.

lessons.title: Advanced Git Techniques
lessons.theory: Git hooks (pre-commit, pre-push). Git submodules. Cherry-pick specific commits. Worktrees cho parallel development. Signed commits.
lessons.code:
# Pre-commit hook (.husky/pre-commit)
npx lint-staged

# lint-staged config (package.json)
# "lint-staged": {
#   "*.{js,ts}": ["eslint --fix", "prettier --write"],
#   "*.css": ["prettier --write"]
# }

# Cherry-pick: apply specific commit from another branch
git cherry-pick abc1234

# Worktrees: multiple working directories
git worktree add ../hotfix hotfix/critical
# Work in ../hotfix without switching branches
# Clean up: git worktree remove ../hotfix

# Interactive rebase: rewrite history
git rebase -i HEAD~5
# Commands:
# pick   = keep commit
# squash = combine with previous
# reword = change commit message
# drop   = remove commit
# edit   = stop to amend

# Signed commits (verify authorship)
git config --global commit.gpgsign true
git commit -S -m "feat: verified commit"

# Git blame with ignoring whitespace changes
git blame -w --ignore-revs-file .git-blame-ignore-revs src/app.js
keyPoints: Pre-commit hooks: lint + format trước khi commit
Cherry-pick: lấy 1 commit cụ thể từ branch khác
Worktrees: work trên nhiều branches cùng lúc
lessons.exercise: Setup husky + lint-staged cho pre-commit linting.

lessons.title: Container Security & Best Practices
lessons.theory: Container security: minimal images, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, network policies. Trivy/Snyk scan. Docker secrets. Read-only filesystems.
lessons.code:
# Security scanning
# docker scout cves myapp:latest
# trivy image myapp:latest

# Secure Dockerfile
FROM node:20-alpine AS base

# Don't run as root
RUN addgroup -S app && adduser -S -G app appuser

# Read-only filesystem
# docker run --read-only --tmpfs /tmp myapp

# Docker secrets (Compose)
# docker-compose.yml
# services:
#   app:
#     secrets:
#       - db_password
# secrets:
#   db_password:
#     file: ./secrets/db_password.txt

# Security hardening
# docker run \
#   --read-only \
#   --no-new-privileges \
#   --security-opt=no-new-privileges:true \
#   --cap-drop=ALL \
#   --cap-add=NET_BIND_SERVICE \
#   myapp

# .trivyignore - ignore known acceptable CVEs
# CVE-2023-12345

# Scan in CI
# - name: Scan image
#   run: trivy image --exit-code 1 --severity HIGH,CRITICAL myapp:latest
keyPoints: Trivy/Snyk scan containers cho vulnerabilities
--cap-drop=ALL + add only needed capabilities
Docker secrets thay environment variables cho sensitive data
lessons.exercise: Audit và harden Docker setup: scan, non-root, secrets.

lessons.title: Kubernetes & Container Orchestration
lessons.theory: Kubernetes (K8s) orchestrate containers at scale. Pods, Services, Deployments, Ingress. Auto-scaling, rolling updates, self-healing.
lessons.code:
# deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: myapp
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: myapp
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: myapp
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: myapp
          image: myapp:latest
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3000
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: "128Mi"
              cpu: "250m"
            limits:
              memory: "256Mi"
              cpu: "500m"
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 3000
            periodSeconds: 10
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: myapp-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: myapp
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 3000
  type: LoadBalancer
keyPoints: Deployment: manage replicas, rolling updates, rollbacks
Service: load balance traffic to pods
Resource limits: memory/cpu requests + limits cho stability
lessons.exercise: Deploy app lên Kubernetes cluster với 3 replicas, auto-scaling.

lessons.title: GitOps & Infrastructure as Code
lessons.theory: GitOps: Git là single source of truth cho infrastructure. ArgoCD, Flux sync cluster state với Git. Terraform/Pulumi cho cloud infrastructure. Immutable deployments.
lessons.code:
# Terraform example (infrastructure as code)
resource "aws_ecs_service" "app" {
  name            = "myapp"
  cluster         = aws_ecs_cluster.main.id
  task_definition = aws_ecs_task_definition.app.arn
  desired_count   = 3

  load_balancer {
    target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
    container_name   = "myapp"
    container_port   = 3000
  }
}

# ArgoCD Application (GitOps)
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: myapp
spec:
  project: default
  source:
    repoURL: https://github.com/org/k8s-manifests
    targetRevision: main
    path: apps/myapp
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
    namespace: production
  syncPolicy:
    automated:
      prune: true
      selfHeal: true

# Flow:
# 1. Developer pushes code → GitHub
# 2. CI builds + tests → pushes Docker image
# 3. CI updates k8s manifests in GitOps repo
# 4. ArgoCD detects change → deploys automatically
# 5. Rollback = git revert on GitOps repo
keyPoints: GitOps: Git repo = desired infrastructure state
ArgoCD/Flux: auto-sync cluster state với Git repo
Terraform: infrastructure as code, plan → apply → destroy
lessons.exercise: Set up GitOps pipeline: code repo → CI → GitOps repo → ArgoCD → K8s.
